purpose: Test one coefficient-free queue-externality certificate on the strongest prior E3 mechanism: retain V117 bit-for-bit and reject its complete alternative whenever replay shows greater admitted-work processor-sharing interference than the exact anchor.

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.strongest_parent: V117 passed all throughput and both QPR gates for spike and sustained bursts, passed pulse throughput, and had positive pulse mean QPR; only the two pulse QPR direction gates failed.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v117_pulse_failure: Two pulse seeds had small negative QPR changes accompanied by both greater latency and greater cost, although the three-seed throughput and QPR means improved.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v131_falsification: Running-first child witness ordering did not generalize: pulse passed, spike throughput/QPR fell, and sustained gained throughput while losing QPR. The complete V131 cohort is retained and no confirmation input was opened.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.queue_externality_gap: V117 protects every current critical-frontier player's own admitted-work service proxy, but it does not separately constrain the equal-share delay that the alternative assignment imposes on all work already admitted to the affected nodes.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.independent_axis: Add the already-defined coefficient-free complete admitted-interference Pareto certificate from V115 after V117 constructs and componentwise-validates its complete alternative. No scenario label, outcome, threshold, ratio, horizon, weight, cap, or fitted margin is added.

closed_axes.admitted_work_definition: pending plus all resident remaining plus same-window projected immutable CPU remains bit-for-bit V117
closed_axes.componentwise_per-choice_interference: remains disabled; V132 adds only the complete replay certificate
closed_axes.completion_proximal_and_terminal_child_a: V123-V131 are failed training branches and are not combined with V132

hypothesis.primary: A V117 substitution can improve every protected critical player's own service while still increasing the processor-sharing interference imposed on already-admitted work. That externality can increase latency and cost enough to reverse QPR during pulsed load.
hypothesis.candidate: Replay the complete anchor and V117 alternative in frozen native player order. For each current critical-frontier player work w, sum min(existing_work,w)/capacity over pending work, every resident remaining work item, and earlier same-window projected work. Accept the V117 alternative only when its complete interference sum is finite and no greater than the anchor sum.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E1379-E1381 cohort.

allowed: all immutable and current-state V117 admitted-work, locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and critical-frontier inputs
the exact anchor and V117 alternative assignments already constructed before dispatch
native player order and the same preplacement node aggregates used by both replays
pending immutable CPU values, every resident task's finite nonnegative remaining CPU, earlier same-window projected immutable CPU, current-player immutable CPU, and node capacity
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, registered burst interval, or time-to-burst-boundary
any result-derived threshold, margin, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap, or smoothing width
formal E01-E20 outcome-dependent selection or confirmation outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.complete_interference_definition: Bit-for-bit V115 complete admitted interference: for each current critical-frontier player with immutable work w, sum min(x,w)/node_capacity over every pending immutable CPU value, every resident remaining CPU value, and every earlier same-window projected immutable CPU value in its replay prefix; then sum across protected players.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any unavailable work value, count mismatch, invalid capacity, nonfinite arithmetic, incomplete assignment, replay infeasibility, componentwise coverage mismatch, or failed frozen V117 certificate preserves the exact anchor assignment.

arms.complete_componentwise_service_rule: every current critical-frontier player's alternative admitted-work service proxy is no greater than its anchor proxy
arms.complete_interference_rule: alternative complete admitted-interference sum is no greater than anchor

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: Enable the coefficient-free complete admitted-interference Pareto certificate on V117's already-constructed complete alternative; every V117 construction and certificate remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without a complete finite componentwise service certificate, a complete finite nonworse interference certificate, and every frozen V117 gate, dispatch exact V94 for identical state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V117 causal-arrival, admitted-work, critical-service, componentwise-service, score, welfare, assignment-hash, and feasibility fields
complete interference gate enabled/evaluated/accepted, anchor sum, alternative sum, alternative-minus-anchor, unavailable count, and rejected count
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V132 profile
